description: This PHP source file defines the LeaveRequestController class, which handles the pre-rendering logic for leave request views in the OrangeHRM leave plugin. It manages access validation, fetches leave request data, and sets up Vue.js components with relevant properties based on the request context.

classes.name: LeaveRequestController
classes.description: Controller class managing leave request view rendering, including validation, data retrieval, and component setup.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the leave request view by validating request parameters, retrieving leave request data, verifying user permissions, and configuring the Vue component with appropriate properties.
